flagged.title: Sampling, Practical and Ethical Issues
flagged.reason: The video repeatedly teaches that there are only three ethical rules required at GCSE, omitting deception which is an examinable specification requirement.

mark_affecting.quote: These three rules are the absolute foundation of sociological ethics, and as a GCSE student, you need to know them by heart. First up, informed consent... Second, confidentiality... And third, harm to participants.
